data.one_liner: Window acrylic, mica and transparency effects for Flutter on Windows, macOS and Linux.
data.what_it_does: Provides window transparency, acrylic, mica, and other advanced desktop visual effects for Flutter applications on Windows, macOS, and Linux. It allows developers to customize window frames, controls, and native background materials programmatically.
use_when: Building desktop Flutter applications for Windows, macOS, or Linux requiring native blur, acrylic, or mica effects.
Customizing native window controls, titlebars, and fullscreen behaviors.
avoid_when: Needing platform UI components beyond window backdrop effects.
strengths: Supports multiple desktop platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux).
Offers fine-grained control over native window blur states and materials.
weaknesses: Requires specific platform version checks or target configurations (e.g., macOS deployment target, Windows 10 vs 11 requirements).
May require custom window frame packages like bitsdojo_window on Windows 10 to prevent blur leaks.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting the macOS deployment target to 10.14.6 or above in Xcode and Podfile.
